settings.heading: Sell your statues
settings.body: We buy outright — no commission, and we never sell on your behalf.

settings.title: Tell us about the piece
settings.text: Character and studio, scale if you know it, and where you are based.

settings.title: Describe the condition
settings.text: Original box and inserts, any repairs, chips, loose parts or missing accessories.

settings.title: Share photographs
settings.text: Several angles in good light, including the base and any damage.

settings.title: We respond with an offer
settings.text: We buy outright. If we can make an offer we will set it out by email, with no obligation on you to accept.

settings.heading: What to send
settings.body: Send a front photo, both sides, the base and close-ups of any damage. Include the character, studio, box details and your location.

settings.label: Original packaging
settings.hint: Box and inserts, yes or no

settings.heading: Or send us the details
settings.body: The more detail you give, the closer our first reply will be to a firm offer.
settings.note: Sending an enquiry does not commit you to anything, and nothing is agreed until you accept an offer in writing.
settings.message_label: Tell us about the piece or collection
settings.message_hint: Character, studio, scale if known, condition, original box and inner packaging, any repairs or missing parts, and your rough location in the UK.
settings.photo_note: Photographs are better sent by email — this form cannot take attachments. Send them to sultan@sultanofstatues.com and we will match them to your enquiry.
settings.success: Thank you — your enquiry has been sent. We will reply by email.
